description: Bank branch directory (MX, CO, AR), one row per branch. Typed, normalized and checked from workspace.bronze.branches.

load.notes: Single CSV snapshot re-delivered in full; incremental runs pick up a new file only when Bronze ingests one.

branch_id.description: Branch identifier (SUC-XXXXXXXX), trimmed and upper-cased. Primary key; referenced by customers, products, service_agents, transactions and complaints (issue 14: most of those references are orphans).

branch_code.description: Short branch code (S + 4 digits), unique per branch.

branch_name.description: Branch display name. Not unique: 175 names for 350 branches, repeated within the same city, so never look a branch up by name.

branch_status.description: Operating status (no timestamp: current state only).

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code derived from country after accent folding; use it for joins across tables.

postal_code.description: FIX: postal code with Colombian codes left-padded to 6 digits (Medellín and Barranquilla lost the leading zero in the source).

geographic_zone.description: Zone type; every branch is urban in the delivered data.

latitude.description: Latitude in decimal degrees; NULL when the raw point lies outside the branch's country (placeholder near 0,0).

longitude.description: Longitude in decimal degrees; NULL when the raw point lies outside the branch's country (placeholder near 0,0).

has_valid_coordinates.description: True when the raw point falls inside the branch's national bounding box. False for all branches of 7 of 16 cities (placeholder coordinates).

phone.description: Branch phone in international format. Mexican branches carry the +54 prefix (see check phone_prefix_matches_country).

opening_time.description: Daily opening time, HH:mm:ss local time.

closing_time.description: Daily closing time, HH:mm:ss local time.

has_atms.description: Whether the branch has ATMs; must agree with atm_count.

atm_count.description: Number of ATMs at the branch.

has_teller_windows.description: Whether the branch has teller windows; must agree with teller_window_count.

checks.name: postal_code_format
checks.expr: CASE country_code WHEN 'MX' THEN postal_code RLIKE '^[0-9]{5}$' WHEN 'CO' THEN postal_code RLIKE '^[0-9]{6}$' WHEN 'AR' THEN postal_code RLIKE '^[A-Z][0-9]{4}([A-Z]{3})?$' END
checks.description: Postal code matches the national format after the fix (MX 5 digits, CO 6 digits, AR CPA).

checks.name: postal_code_as_delivered
checks.description: Counts rows whose postal code was re-padded (FIX applied).

checks.name: coordinates_in_country
checks.description: Raw coordinates fall inside the branch's country; failures are placeholder points near (0, 0), nulled in latitude/longitude.

checks.name: phone_prefix_matches_country
checks.expr: phone LIKE CASE country_code WHEN 'MX' THEN '+52 %' WHEN 'CO' THEN '+57 %' WHEN 'AR' THEN '+54 %' END
checks.description: International dialing prefix matches the branch's country.

checks.name: business_hours_valid
checks.description: Opening and closing times are HH:mm:ss and the branch opens before it closes.

checks.name: has_atms_matches_count
checks.expr: has_atms IS NULL OR atm_count IS NULL OR has_atms = (atm_count > 0)
checks.description: has_atms is true exactly when atm_count > 0.

checks.name: has_teller_windows_matches_count
checks.expr: has_teller_windows IS NULL OR teller_window_count IS NULL OR has_teller_windows = (teller_window_count > 0)
checks.description: has_teller_windows is true exactly when teller_window_count > 0.

checks.name: opening_date_not_future
checks.expr: branch_opening_date IS NULL OR branch_opening_date <= current_date()
checks.description: The branch did not open in the future.
